name: Frontend Design
summary: Agent skill that guides distinctive frontend interface design and rejects generic AI aesthetics through deliberate design choices.
description: A SKILL.md package that approaches UI work as a design lead: choose an aesthetic direction first (brutalist, maximalist, retro-futuristic, luxury, organic and others), then build with intentional typography, CSS-variable color theming, motion, spatial composition and textural detail. It generates working HTML/CSS/JS, React or Vue code and avoids overused fonts, clichéd color schemes and predictable layouts.
contains: aesthetic directions: brutalist, maximalist, retro-futuristic, luxury, organic
design pillars: typography, color theming, motion, spatial composition, texture
generates HTML/CSS/JS, React and Vue code
avoids overused fonts, clichéd colors and predictable layouts
